preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or an authorized address
Contract must have BNB balance in its treasury

exploit_hint: As owner or authorized address, call clearStuckBalance(100) to drain all BNB from contract to marketingFeeReceiver, or call manualSend() to transfer entire contract balance to marketingFeeReceiver. Alternatively, set fee receivers to attacker-controlled addresses using setFeeReceivers() and trigger swapBack() to redirect funds.
